sentences.en: I will tell you what love is. It's very embarrassing.
sentences.zh: 我会告诉你什么是爱。这非常令人尴尬。

sentences.en: This is, without a doubt, an embarrassing situation for me.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，这种情况对我来说很让人难堪。

sentences.en: This is the most embarrassing moment of my life.
sentences.zh: 这是我一生中最令人尴尬的时刻。

senses.zh: 使人尴尬的，令人为难的v.（使）窘迫，（使）局促不安( embarrass的现在分词)
